Remark
[Horizontal Laplacian convention and the barrier-inequality limit] The operator $\triangle $ is the horizontal Laplacian on the slice $M\times \{ t=T-\tau \} $ with metric $g(T-\tau )$.

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[l_x achieves its minimum and the minimizing set is compact]
